text: Lina (PM): Quick design review — uploaded a short prototype for the streaming chat controls + token counter and prompt-library insert. pls skim: https://figma.com/file/xyz. Main asks: stop/regenerate labels, token counter placement, prompt library accessibility. Evan (Designer): Love the compact composer bar. A11y nit: use explicit labels for action buttons — screen readers need context. e.g. 'Stop generation' not just 'Stop'. Tooltip on hover helps. :mag: Sam (Frontend): +1 on explicit label. Implementation note: current stream container uses aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="true" — that causes whole region to be read every chunk. Recommend aria-atomic="false" and role="status" so partial updates don't spam SRs. Maya (Eng): Behavior question: is "Stop" destructive? it just interrupts generation, doesn't delete text. That affects copy. Maybe use 'Interrupt' as the verb to be precise? Darla (Content): 'Interrupt' reads technical to end users. Prefer plain language: 'Stop generating' or 'Pause generation' depending on whether we allow resume. Lina (PM): UX research quick tip: test with non-technical users — they expect two actions: stop and regenerate. For keyboard shortcuts, thinking Ctrl/Cmd+Enter = regenerate, Esc = stop? open to alternatives. Sam (Frontend): Esc conflicts with modals/escape sequences. Suggest Cmd/Ctrl+. or Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Enter for regen. Also need focus styles for the control group. a11y-bot: Reminder: buttons must have accessible names, visible focus outlines, 4.5:1 contrast. For the prompt library list, provide a skip link and ensure each list item has a clear role and label. Maya (Eng): Token counter placement: inline below the composer feels noisy on mobile. Proposal: desktop show inline right of send row, mobile collapse into an expander or move into status rail. Also note that batching means token counts update in leaps — debounce UI updates to ~200ms to avoid layout thrash. Evan (Designer): Visual idea: animate a small per-chunk token delta briefly then consolidate into the total count. That gives feedback without flicker. For color, use semantic info color, not red/green. Darla (Content): Microcopy proposals: - Stop button: 'Stop generation' (tooltip: 'Interrupt the current response; content so far will remain'). - Regenerate: 'Regenerate response' (tooltip: 'Send the same prompt again'). - Token counter: simplified label 'Tokens: 123' with optional tooltip 'Estimated cost: $0.01' (hide cost for free-tier flows). Lina (PM): Prompt library insert accessibility: screen readers should announce "Insert prompt: " before the action. Avoid modal-only patterns; use a tray with focus management. Sam (Frontend): Quick code snippet for the streaming region (rough): ``` <div role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false">Streaming…</div> ``` Also: give the stop button aria-pressed or aria-disabled states appropriately during requests. Maya (Eng): Backend note: batching/quantization makes token counts approximate until finalization. We'll expose 'estimated' tag and final reconciliation when the request completes. Frontend should tolerate jumps. Evan (Designer): Accessibility detail: make sure the "Stop" visual affordance has at least 44px tap target on mobile and visible focus ring for keyboard navigation. Darla (Content): Slight language tweak for tooltip tone: keep verbs active and short. Avoid jargon like "interrupt" where possible. Lina (PM): Action items: Evan — update Figma with explicit labels + mobile drawer layout. Sam — implement aria-live change, focus outlines, keyboard shortcut proposal. Maya — debounce token UI updates and add estimated/final token flags in the API. Darla — finalize microcopy for buttons and tooltips. Sync Monday 10am for sign-off. Thanks all! :thumbsup: Sam (Frontend): copy that. I'll PR the aria change and the keyboard shortcut proposal today. Maya (Eng): I'll add the estimated vs final token fields to the response payload and set the debounce on the streaming websocket messages. Evan (Designer): I'll push frames for desktop/mobile and add the token delta micro-animation. Darla (Content): I'll land the microcopy and write the tooltip helper text. a11y-bot: Quick checklist added to the thread: focus order, aria labels, role=status for stream, 44px targets, color contrast >= 4.5:1. Lina (PM): Great, wrapping up here. See you Monday.
